::: {#def-bca-bias-correction}
#### Bias correction of the BCa interval

For a statistic $\hparam$ and its bootstrap replicates
$\hparam^*_1, \ldots, \hparam^*_B$,
the **bias correction** is

$$\hat{z}_0 \eqdef \normcdf^{-1}\paren{\frac{\#\cb{b : \hparam^*_b < \hparam}}{B}},$$

where $\normcdf$ is the standard Gaussian CDF.
:::
